subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents.”?
options: Their report helped the city decide where to add shelters first.
The school agreed to add one fountain first and review the need for another.
A city wanted to add colorful lights to a historic bridge to attract tourists.
The city office finally agreed to paint a new crossing and add a warning light.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents. Their report helped the city decide where to add shelters first.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The school agreed to add one fountain first and review the need for another.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A city wanted to add colorful lights to a historic bridge to attract tourists.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
